violations.description: No automated test files or test suites exist in the repository.
violations.evidence: No test directory or test files (*_test.py, test_*.py, *.test.*, *.spec.*) are present, and package.json specifies 'echo "Error: no test specified" && exit 1'.
violations.recommendation: Implement an automated test suite for the application components and integrate test execution into CI.

violations.description: Node.js package manifests exist without any corresponding lockfile.
violations.evidence: src/backdoor-demo/package.json and src/exfiltration-demo/package.json exist, but package-lock.json (and other lockfiles) are missing.
violations.recommendation: Generate and commit a lockfile (e.g. package-lock.json) to ensure reproducible dependency resolutions.

violations.description: No code linter, formatter, or pre-commit configuration is present in the repository.
violations.evidence: Config files for linters/formatters (eslint, prettier, ruff, flake8, pre-commit) are all missing.
violations.recommendation: Configure a linter and formatter (e.g., ESLint/Prettier for JavaScript) and add it to CI or pre-commit hooks.

violations.description: A GitHub Actions workflow pins a third-party action to a mutable branch reference instead of an immutable version tag or SHA.
violations.recommendation: Pin third-party GitHub Actions to an immutable version tag (e.g. @v2) or full commit SHA.

violations.description: .gitignore is inadequate and misses standard entries like node_modules/, dist/, build/, and .env.
violations.recommendation: Add standard language-specific ignore patterns (node_modules/, dist/, build/, .env, etc.) to .gitignore.
